title.en: Launcher 1.0.10: play offline without signing in

summary.en: Choose Play offline on the first screen: profiles, mods and offline play work without an account, and nothing is sent to Infinity's servers.
summary.pt-BR: Escolha Jogar offline na primeira tela: perfis, mods e o jogo offline funcionam sem conta, e nada é enviado aos servidores do Infinity.
